entities.name: Frederick Ferdinand, Duke of Anhalt-Köthen
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Frederick Ferdinand of Anhalt-Köthen was a German prince, Ascanian ruler of the principality of Anhalt-Pless and, from 1818, of the duchy of Anhalt-Köthen. He was the second son of Frederick Erdmann, Prince of Anhalt-Pless, and his wife, Countess Louise Ferdinande of Stolberg-Wernigerode, daughter of Henry Ernest, Count of Stolberg-Wernigerode.
